title: AWS Summit Johannesburg
heading: AWS Secrets: How to read your cloud resources bedtime stories
body: Want to save big on your AWS bill? We found the secret: teach your resources to take naps! By using AWS scheduler to shut down and start resources in our non-production account, we cut our operational costs by over 50%. Come hear the inside scoop from morning wake-up calls to start the day to night-night lullabies. This recipe will repeat and save you every day! Let your resources get their beauty sleep!
